name: event_id
description: UUID per event; used as insertId for best-effort dedup on retries

name: event_ts
description: UTC time the event was written

name: prl1_only
description: ship to UAT+PRL1 only, never PRD (queued events)

name: df_only
description: Dataflow image, excluded from helm deploys (queued events)

name: note
description: note to DevOps or action tag (release_promoted / removed_from_live / df_workflow_dispatched)

name: release_name
description: release the artifact shipped in (released events)

name: build_verified
description: courtesy build check at queue time; null = not checked

name: environment
description: deployed/removed events: uat | prd | prl1 | dataflow-uat

name: jira_ticket
description: e.g. REL-1234; surfaces in the CHG draft

name: build_run_url
description: GitHub Actions run that built the tag — eligibility evidence checked at queue time
